verdict.rationale: Puzzle's API getting-started docs name a sandbox server (staging.southparkdata.com) separate from the production server (api.puzzle.io). They also describe test-prefixed sandbox credentials, so a user can test API calls in true environment isolation rather than a dry run against production data. Access is not self-serve: sandbox credentials must be requested by email and are provisioned manually. Missing for 10: self-serve sandbox provisioning, documentation of sandbox data seeding and parity with production, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
